newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber ends with limit gains in January, March.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber ends with limit gains in January, March.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed with limit gains in January and March contracts and higher in deferred months.
Traders said recent bullish home sales reports and talk of strong cash markets fueled much of the buying.
Commercial and speculative buying was noted through the session and encountered very little seller resistance.
"There is hardly anything for sale in our decks," said one trader early in the session.
The latest bullish report came from the U.S. Commerce Department early Tuesday, which reported November U.S. home sales rose 14.2 percent, the greatest monthly increase since April 1993.
Lumber closed up $10.00 to $2.80, with January up the limit at $424.70. March was up $10.00 at $417.30, a contract high.
